items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Maxine Sullivan for the last three years has thrilled thousands of people here on Long Island with Johnny Blowers and the (Inaudible) of jazz.

ctx.x: Maxine Sullivan received a letter from Johnny Blowers, (phonetic spelling), it says, "To Whom It May Concern: Maxine Sullivan for the last three years has thrilled thousands of people here on Long Island with Johnny Blowers and the (Inaudible) of jazz. Your songs and your general ways have caused everyone to fall in love with you. I personally can think of no other way to call you except "The Great Lady of Song." (Very appropriate) May your House (sic-Jazz) That Jack Built become the highest and best that ever…
